messages.subject: NIMBLE virtual workshop, May 26-28
parts:
Hi all,

We’ll be holding a NIMBLE virtual training workshop, May 26-28, from 8 am to 1 pm US Pacific (California) time.

Details can be found here.

If you are interested in attending, please pre-register at https://forms.gle/6AtNgfdUdvhni32Q6. This will hold a spot for you and allow us to learn about your specific interests. 

-Chris
For the NIMBLE Development Team
